about: Anthropic's list prices for its API, in US dollars per million tokens, as published on 3 November 2026. AI usage uses them to estimate what Claude Code's use would cost on the API; for a subscription that is not a bill. A cache write costs the input price times cacheWrite5m (written for 5 minutes) or cacheWrite1h (for 1 hour); a cache read costs the model's cacheRead, else its input price times cacheRead; fast mode (speed fast) costs every price times the model's fast, and a model with no fast price leaves fast use out of the cost.
